records.strongest_null: Ordinary issue preference, partisan identity, economic or regional interest, and movement belonging can produce the observed status language without institutional subordination.
records.overclaim_attack: The ethnographic mechanism cannot be extrapolated into a national motive denominator, exact selector, material consequence chain, or common-purpose finding.
records.decisive_discriminator: Join a representative motive denominator to an exact institutional rule, affected rows, material consequence, and correction or non-correction receipt.
records.recommended_authority_ceiling: bounded status-restoration mechanism in the studied population only
records.counterreview_finding: The mechanism survives the ordinary-explanation attack only at the studied-population level; every national, institutional, causal, and remedial extension remains unsupported.

records.strongest_null: Party identification, ideology, immigration policy preference, and heterogeneous individual motives can explain the association without a common nested-superiority mechanism.
records.overclaim_attack: Associational evidence cannot identify every respondent's motive, estimate prevalence, or establish an institutional gate and consequence topology.
records.decisive_discriminator: Recover the complete category and electorate denominator, the exact deservingness rule, the institutional gate applying it, affected rows, consequences, and correction paths.
records.recommended_authority_ceiling: candidate nested-superiority association without individual-motive, prevalence, or material-chain authority
records.counterreview_finding: The mechanism remains plausible but cannot advance until the association is joined to a complete selector, affected-population, consequence, and correction denominator.

records.strongest_null: The coalition can be genuinely multiracial and internally heterogeneous, with economic, religious, partisan, formally colorblind, or egalitarian motives that do not compose into one racial order.
records.overclaim_attack: Demographic composition identifies neither individual motive nor authority and proves neither neutrality nor tokenism.
records.decisive_discriminator: Trace institution-specific selection rules, authority, burdens, outcomes, and correction across coalition segments rather than inferring order from composition.
records.recommended_authority_ceiling: genuinely multiracial coalition with bounded hierarchy-attitude overlap only
records.counterreview_finding: The packet survives only as a heterogeneity finding; composition and attitude associations cannot carry motive, order, conditional-incorporation, or selector-control claims.

records.strongest_null: Represented members may possess real authority, diversity may be descriptive rather than a neutrality claim, and the institution may be effectively contestable.
records.overclaim_attack: Presence-versus-power vocabulary does not establish tokenism, hierarchy, or lack of remedy in any bounded institution.
records.decisive_discriminator: Obtain one complete institutional denominator covering roster, selection, role authority, veto and budget power, outcomes, burdens, evidence access, and remedy.
records.recommended_authority_ceiling: valid presence-versus-power discriminator without an institution-specific finding
records.counterreview_finding: The discriminator is useful, but the packet has no bounded institution on which to test representation, authority, outcome, burden, access, or correction.

records.strongest_null: Lawful presidential personnel authority, unstated performance reasons, and continuity through acting inspectors general can explain the removals without a durable checking-function collapse.
records.overclaim_attack: A removal instrument and procedural concern do not establish motive, every interrupted investigation, final illegality, replacement effects, or system-wide counterpower loss.
records.decisive_discriminator: Trace investigation and audit continuity, acting replacements, access to records, downstream findings, legal resolution, and practical correction for each affected office.
records.recommended_authority_ceiling: bounded checking-function interruption candidate, not established durable convergence
records.counterreview_finding: The observed action supports a bounded interruption candidate, but durable functional convergence depends on downstream continuity, replacement, outcome, and remedy evidence.

records.strongest_null: Ordinary presidential appointment, Senate confirmation, public strategic priorities, and independent institutional convergence fully explain the retained record.
records.overclaim_attack: Prior employment, shared vocabulary, officeholding, and policy similarity are not receipts for private-to-public personnel routing or policy translation.
records.decisive_discriminator: Produce an exact private artifact-to-actor-to-public-decision chain with timestamps, custody, decision authority, and competing-cause exclusion.
records.recommended_authority_ceiling: public appointment and policy surface with no private-to-public translation receipt
records.counterreview_finding: The packet is a strong negative control: the public facts are real, but the claimed translation edge is absent and must not be inferred.

records.strongest_null: Reasonable integrated-system procurement, open competition, justified evaluation, and ordinary incumbent or architecture advantage can explain the record.
records.overclaim_attack: Denied protests and later vendor success establish neither improper foreclosure nor a fair complete option set, technical superiority, support parity, or counterfactual necessity.
records.decisive_discriminator: Recover the complete bidder and architecture universe, comparable testing and support, evaluation records, performance, excluded alternatives, later necessity claims, substitution, exit, and public recovery.
records.recommended_authority_ceiling: competition and protest access observed; later support asymmetry and counterfactual foreclosure unresolved
records.counterreview_finding: The target-only story fails because competition and review occurred, but the ordinary-procurement null also remains incomplete without the full option, support, performance, substitution, and exit record.

records.strongest_null: Ordinary statutory interpretation and case-specific appellate correction explain the unanimous decision without institutional transformation or a general anti-DEI program.
records.overclaim_attack: Vacatur and remand do not decide the discrimination merits, validate categorical anti-DEI enforcement, or establish system-wide remedy availability.
records.decisive_discriminator: Observe the remand merits, comparable burden-correction cases, repeatability of access to correction, implementation, and practical relief.
records.recommended_authority_ceiling: one independent institution removed a group-specific evidentiary burden and returned the case for ordinary merits review
records.counterreview_finding: The evidence supports a bounded counterpower control, while the current canonical disposition label is semantically mismatched to the packet's judicial-correction function.
